title: The Potential Mismatch Between Japan and the US on China
gist: Ahead of a Trump–Xi meeting in Washington on September 24, Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae is seeking a meeting with Trump during the UN General Assembly, with nothing decided as of September 17; the author flags a potential mismatch between Tokyo and Washington on China policy.

insights.claim: Japan and the United States may be diverging in their approaches to China, with Tokyo concerned that Washington could strike arrangements with Beijing without aligning with Japan's priorities.
insights.speaker: Terrence Matsuo
insights.so_what: A US–China thaw that bypasses Japan would raise Japanese strategic uncertainty and could push higher Japanese defense spending.
